title: The Only Humans to Ever Die in Space Itself

scenes.voiceover: Only three human beings have ever died in space itself. And their capsule landed on target, completely undamaged.
scenes.mainText: ONLY 3 HUMANS HAVE EVER DIED IN SPACE ITSELF

scenes.voiceover: June 1971. Three cosmonauts are heading home after a record 23 days aboard the first space station in history.
scenes.mainText: 23 DAYS ON THE FIRST SPACE STATION

scenes.voiceover: During separation, a valve jars open at 168 kilometers up, above the internationally recognized edge of space. They aren't wearing pressure suits. There wasn't room.
The capsule lands perfectly, right on target. Recovery crews open the hatch and find all three men still strapped into their seats.
The cause of death: asphyxiation, in under a minute, from the sudden loss of cabin pressure. To this day, no one else has died above that line.
scenes.mainText: STILL TRUE TODAY. NO ONE ELSE.

scenes.voiceover: They're 3 of 18 people who've died flying to space. What happened to every one of them is on the channel.
scenes.mainText: 18 PEOPLE. THE FULL STORY → ON THE CHANNEL
